name: Grossglockner - Stüdlgrat
description: The classic ridge climb on Austria's highest peak.
fullDescription:
Approach: From Stüdlhütte, hike the glacier for 1.5 hours to the base of the ridge. 

Pitch 1-4: Easy scrambling (II) to the breakfast block. 

Crux: A steep 15m slab rated III+, well protected with a fixed cable. 

Descent: Downclimb the normal route (Kleinglockner) back to Erzherzog-Johann-Hütte.

name: Zugspitze - Höllental
description: Varied alpine route through the Höllental gorge.
fullDescription:
Approach: Start at Hammersbach, hike through the gorge (fee required).

Glacier: Crampons required for the Höllentalferner. Watch for the massive randkluft (crevasse) at the transition to the rock!

Via Ferrata: Steep B/C climbing all the way to the golden cross at the summit.
